name: Addepar MCP
description:
Addepar’s MCP connector brings portfolio data and intelligence into Claude, enabling investment professionals to ask questions in plain language and receive answers grounded in their firm’s Addepar data.

Analyze a household’s holdings, market value, asset allocation, and performance. Understand alternatives exposure across capital calls, distributions, NAVs, and unfunded commitments. Review transactions, identify trends across clients, or gather the data needed to prepare for a quarterly review.

Unlike tools that analyze accounts in isolation, Addepar understands the ownership structures and relationships connecting a client’s complete portfolio. This allows Claude to provide a consolidated household view across accounts and entities, including public and private investments. Permission aware access helps limit the information retrieved to what each user is authorized to see.

Simply authenticate with your Addepar account. No API keys or manual configuration required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Addepar MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Addepar MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.addepar.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Addepar MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addepar MCP lists 15 MCP tools, including get_all_entities, get_current_user, get_exposure, get_ownership_graph, get_performance_attribution, get_portfolio_attribute_metadata, get_portfolio_data, get_private_fund_cash_movements, get_transaction_attribute_metadata, get_transactions, get_upcoming_private_fund_capital_activity, and search_addepar_product_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Addepar MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Addepar MCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Addepar MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addepar MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Addepar MCP is developed by Addepar. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
